         4                  Senator Klein.

         5                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

         6       I believe there's a privileged resolution at

         7       the desk.

         8                  I ask that the resolution be read

         9       in its entirety and move for its immediate

        10       adoption and to have Senator Thompson have the

        11       opportunity to speak on his resolution.

        12                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        13       The Secretary will read.

        14                  THE SECRETARY:    By Senator

        15       Thompson, Legislative Resolution Number 254,

        16       memorializing Governor David A. Paterson to

        17       proclaim April 2009 as Electronics Recycling

        18       Month in the State of New York.

        19                  "WHEREAS, It is the custom of this

        20       Legislative Body to proclaim specific events

        21       that bring attention and awareness to

        22       important issues that affect the lives of the

        23       people living in this great Empire State; and

        24                  "WHEREAS, Attendant to such



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         278



         1       concern, and in full accord with its

         2       long-standing traditions, this Legislative

         3       Body is justly proud to memorialize Governor

         4       David A. Paterson to proclaim April 2009 as

         5       Electronics Recycling Month in the State of

         6       New York; and

         7                  "WHEREAS, This Legislative Body

         8       finds and declares that electronic equipment,

         9       which contains priority contaminants that are

        10       a cause of concern such as cathode ray tubes,

        11       printed circuit boards, batteries, lead, and

        12       other components, can have significant

        13       toxicological effects on humans and the

        14       environment when improperly disposed; and

        15                  "WHEREAS, Beginning June 12, 2009,

        16       federal law will require that all full-power

        17       television broadcast stations stop

        18       broadcasting in analog format and broadcast

        19       only in digital format; and

        20                  "WHEREAS, In anticipation of the

        21       possibility that large quantities of

        22       televisions will become obsolete as of said

        23       date, it is the duty of the State of New York

        24       and its local governments to encourage and



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         279



         1       organize electronics recycling events

         2       throughout the month of April 2009 and all

         3       Aprils thereafter, until legislation is passed

         4       making such practice law; and

         5                  "WHEREAS, The State of Minnesota

         6       Legislature enacted the Minnesota Electronics

         7       Recycling Act of 2007, which became effective

         8       on July 1, 2007; and

         9                  "WHEREAS, Since the enactment of

        10       the Minnesota Electronics Recycling Act of

        11       2007, 33.6 million pounds of Covered

        12       Electronic Devices have been diverted from the

        13       waste stream and properly recycled according

        14       to environmental regulations; and

        15                  "WHEREAS, From the total amount of

        16       Covered Electronic Devices collected and

        17       recycled, 45 percent came from special events

        18       throughout the State of Minnesota; and

        19                  "WHEREAS, Getting in the habit of

        20       recycling is of significant importance to the

        21       environment and to the people residing in the

        22       communities of New York State as well as those

        23       living throughout the United States of

        24       America; now, therefore, be it



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         280



         1                  "RESOLVED, That this Legislative

         2       Body pause in its deliberations to memorialize

         3       Governor David A. Paterson to proclaim April

         4       2009 as Electronics Recycling Month in the

         5       State of New York; and be it further

         6                  "RESOLVED, That a copy of this

         7       resolution, suitably engrossed, be transmitted

         8       to the Honorable David A. Paterson, Governor

         9       of the State of New York."

        10                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        11       Senator Thompson.

        12                  SENATOR THOMPSON:    Yes, Madam

        13       Chairwoman, I first want to say this is a very

        14       important resolution.

        15                  I think what we see happening on

        16       the national level with our new president,

        17       Barack Obama, really promoting the

        18       environment, climate change, and so many

        19       green-related issues.  And this body has long

        20       championed issues related to the environment.

        21                  We know that the United States of

        22       America, since 2005, every year is putting

        23       more and more computers into the waste stream.

        24       And that's why it's so important to really



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         281



         1       complement the efforts of local communities

         2       that are promoting electronic recycling.  And

         3       the state needs to do a better job in leading

         4       that charge.

         5                  So for example, since 2005, every

         6       year -- in 2005 alone, 47 million computers in

         7       our nation were thrown away.  And so states

         8       all across the United States of America are

         9       moving forward with this issue.

        10                  And the reason why this is also so

        11       important in our state is as we think about

        12       when these computers are taken out of the

        13       garbage, they're actually sent, in many

        14       places, overseas.  Just last year in 2008, and

        15       in addition in 2007, different national

        16       publications documented how the individuals

        17       were going to third-world nations like Ghana,

        18       Nigeria, and the other places where they

        19       actually smash these computers, they try to

        20       burn them as best they can, so they can get

        21       whatever materials that are available.

        22                  And you can see them in Time

        23       magazine, National Geographic, where these

        24       individuals with no protective gear are trying



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         282



         1       to get all of the things that are salvageable

         2       and then wind up harming themselves and

         3       getting all types of illnesses.

         4                  So anything that the states can do,

         5       particularly like New York State, to promote

         6       electronic recycling I think can be extremely

         7       helpful.

         8                  One of the other things that I

         9       wanted to note as well.  Whether you look at

        10       countries like Nigeria or Ghana or Pakistan or

        11       China or India where children are often seen

        12       sorting through computers, inhaling all types

        13       of toxic materials.  And if we can work hard

        14       at this issue, I think we will make the world

        15       a better place.

        16                  Let me also say that there are a

        17       lot of different things that we can do outside

        18       of having our own law in the state.  Many of

        19       our members, through their various

        20       newsletters, through working with

        21       environmental groups and their local

        22       governments, we can also play a role during

        23       the month of April in promoting electronic

        24       recycling.  It's extremely important.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         283



         1                  If we look at our cellphones, if we

         2       look at our computers, every month there's a

         3       new computer that comes out.  And as computers

         4       become obsolete, we throw our old printers in

         5       the garbage, we throw those old ink cartridges

         6       in the garbage.  We look at those monitors as

         7       well.

         8                  These things we must do a better

         9       job of protecting.  And if we think about

        10       what's going to happen this year in June with

        11       all these outdated televisions -- you know, I

        12       personally like my old TV that I got in 1989

        13       for $120.  I've lost two televisions since

        14       then, but the one I bought secondhand for $120

        15       when I was a student at SUNY Brockport, it's

        16       still working.

        17                  But you know what?  That television

        18       is not environmentally friendly.  Many of

        19       these old TVs have lead in them.  And those

        20       TVs, many of them will be thrown away right at

        21       the curbside today, tomorrow, and every day

        22       over the next few days and the next coming

        23       months.

        24                  We have to do a better job of



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         284



         1       trying to contain these materials and trying

         2       to find a way so that we can dispose of them

         3       in an environmentally friendly way.

         4                  So I thank you.  I won't take any

         5       more of your time.  But I think this is a very

         6       important resolution.  We have to make sure

         7       that we "green" New York.  I know that last

         8       year the Senate Democrats talked about the

         9       Green Apple Initiative.  Well, we want to grow

        10       that Green Apple tree this year so that we can

        11       make New York State a better place.

        12                  Thank you.

        13                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        14       Thank you, Senator Thompson.

        15                  Senator Oppenheimer.

        16                  SENATOR OPPENHEIMER:    I'd like to

        17       commend the sponsor of this resolution.

        18                  This is an issue that I first

        19       started studying about six years ago when

        20       Inform, which is an environmental think tank

        21       in New York City, put out a large study, which

        22       was written by one of my best friends,

        23       concerning electronic recycling in Europe,

        24       particularly specifically in Germany.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         285



         1                  And at that time it interested me,

         2       and I started to pursue it.  It turns out that

         3       cellphones, there are millions and millions of

         4       cellphones that are being discarded along with

         5       our regular garbage waste.  And computers are

         6       larger and more significant to see, but the

         7       number of cellphones that is going to

         8       contaminate our landfills is amazing.  I've

         9       lost track of the multiples of millions.

        10                  In my community we started

        11       recycling many, many years ago when I was the

        12       mayor there.  And we now do have electronic

        13       recycling.  We have it once a month, and we

        14       have it on a day that is easy to see because

        15       it is the fifth Wednesday of each month, which

        16       comes around like every three months you'll

        17       have a fifth -- whatever, a fifth Tuesday, a

        18       fifth Wednesday.  And that is when we take all

        19       electronic products.  And we have been able to

        20       sell them back to the originators.

        21                  But I think what is done in Europe,

        22       which I think is very interesting, is that the

        23       responsibility to return the products is to

        24       the manufacturer.  And we might have some



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         286



         1       difficulty selling this concept to some of our

         2       businesses, but I think it really makes great

         3       sense.  Because then they can reprocess pieces

         4       of this electronic equipment and it can be of

         5       value to them.

         6                  So I think that's something that we

         7       all should be looking at, perhaps thinking for

         8       legislation during this year.

         9                  Thank you.

        10                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        11       Thank you, Senator Oppenheimer.

        12                  Are there any other Senators who

        13       wish to be heard on the resolution?

        14                  The question is on the resolution.

        15       All those in favor please signify by saying

        16       aye.

        17                  (Response of "Aye.")

        18                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        19       Opposed, nay.

        20                  (No response.)

        21                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        22       The resolution is adopted.

        24       resolution is open for multisponsorship by the

         2       multisponsor of the resolution should so

         3       inform the desk.
